sentences.text: Desde que la empresa cerró la sede del centro, Javier trabaja permanentemente desde la oficina del polígono.
sentences.en: Since the company closed its downtown office, Javier has worked permanently from the office in the industrial park.
sentences.ko: 회사가 시내 사무실을 닫은 뒤로 하비에르는 줄곧 공단 사무실에서 일해요.

sentences.text: Marta le escribió a Rosa que se había mudado permanentemente al pueblo de sus abuelos.
sentences.en: Marta wrote to Rosa that she had moved permanently to her grandparents' village.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 할머니 할아버지가 사시던 마을로 아예 이사했다고 편지를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Para ir a la reunión en la isla, Javier tuvo que coger el transbordador de las siete.
sentences.en: To get to the meeting on the island, Javier had to take the early ferry.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 섬에서 열리는 회의에 가려고 아침 일찍 출발하는 여객선을 타야 했어요.

sentences.text: En su carta, Marta recordaba el viaje en transbordador que hizo con Rosa a los veinte años.
sentences.en: In her letter, Marta remembered the ferry trip she took with Rosa when they were twenty.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 편지에서 스무 살 때 로사와 함께 배를 타고 떠났던 여행을 떠올렸어요.

sentences.text: Tantos correos sin leer empiezan a abrumar a Javier cada lunes por la mañana.
sentences.en: So many unread emails start to overwhelm Javier every Monday morning.
sentences.ko: 월요일 아침마다 하비에르는 읽지 않은 메일이 너무 많아서 압도당하기 시작해요.

sentences.text: Marta no quería abrumar a su amiga con malas noticias, así que escribió sobre su jardín.
sentences.en: Marta didn't want to overwhelm her friend with bad news, so she wrote about her garden.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 친구에게 나쁜 소식으로 부담을 주기 싫어서 정원 이야기를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Javier hace copias de seguridad regularmente desde que perdió un informe entero.
sentences.en: Javier makes backups regularly since he lost an entire report.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 보고서를 통째로 날린 뒤로 정기적으로 백업을 해요.

sentences.text: Durante años, Marta y Rosa se escribieron regularmente, una carta cada mes.
sentences.en: For years, Marta and Rosa wrote to each other regularly, one letter each month.

sentences.text: Cuando el cliente canceló el contrato, el jefe de Javier no pudo contener la cólera.
sentences.en: When the client cancelled the contract, Javier's boss couldn't contain his anger.
sentences.ko: 고객이 계약을 취소하자 하비에르의 상사는 화를 참지 못했어요.

sentences.text: Marta confesó en la carta que había roto la foto en un ataque de cólera y que se arrepentía.
sentences.en: Marta confessed in the letter that she had torn up the photo in a fit of anger and regretted it.

sentences.text: A media mañana, Javier se come una pera en su mesa mientras revisa el correo.
sentences.en: Mid-morning, Javier eats a pear at his desk while checking his email.

sentences.text: Marta le contó a Rosa que el peral del patio había dado la primera pera del año.
sentences.en: Marta told Rosa that the pear tree in the yard had given its first pear of the year.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 마당 배나무에서 올해 첫 배가 열렸다고 전했어요.

sentences.text: Para Javier es un fastidio que la impresora se atasque justo antes de cada reunión.
sentences.en: For Javier it's a nuisance that the printer jams right before every meeting.

sentences.text: Qué fastidio, escribió Marta, que el cartero ya solo pase por el pueblo dos veces por semana.

sentences.en: Javier left the banana peel in the bin and his coworker complained about the smell.

sentences.text: Dentro del sobre, Marta metió una cáscara de nuez pintada, como hacían de niñas.
sentences.en: Inside the envelope, Marta put a painted walnut shell, as they used to do as girls.

sentences.text: La oficina de Javier está en un edificio moderno junto a una muralla medieval.

sentences.text: Marta le preguntó a Rosa si seguía trabajando para la misma aerolínea.

sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 아직도 같은 항공사에서 일하느냐고 물었어요.

sentences.text: Al vaciar el despacho del antiguo director, Javier sintió una extraña nostalgia.
sentences.en: While clearing out the former director's office, Javier felt a strange nostalgia.

sentences.en: Rereading the old letters, Marta was overcome with nostalgia.
sentences.ko: 옛 편지를 다시 읽자 마르타는 그리움에 휩싸였어요.

sentences.text: En verano, la recepcionista reparte una paleta de helado a cada empleado, y Javier siempre elige la de limón.
sentences.en: In summer, the receptionist hands out an ice lolly to each employee, and Javier always picks lemon.

sentences.text: Marta recordó en su carta la paleta de pintora que compartían en clase de arte.
sentences.en: Marta recalled in her letter the painter's palette they shared in art class.

sentences.en: Marta wrote the letter in a great hurry so as not to miss the postman.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 집배원을 놓치지 않으려고 아주 서둘러 편지를 썼어요.

sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 아들이 지금 식품 공장에서 일한다고 전했어요.

sentences.ko: 하비에르는 퇴근길에 정육점에 들러 저녁거리를 사요.

sentences.ko: 편지에는 마르타와 로사가 어릴 때 초리소를 사던 정육점이 아직 문을 연다고 적혀 있었어요.

sentences.en: Javier's great-grandfather was a blacksmith, and he keeps an old horseshoe in his office.

sentences.text: Marta le escribió a Rosa que el viejo herrero del pueblo por fin se había jubilado.
sentences.en: Marta wrote to Rosa that the old village blacksmith had finally retired.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 마을의 늙은 대장장이가 드디어 은퇴했다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: El nuevo programa permite a Javier monitorear las ventas en tiempo real.
sentences.en: The new software lets Javier monitor sales in real time.

sentences.en: Marta explained to Rosa that she now uses an app to monitor her blood sugar.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 요즘 혈당을 확인하려고 앱을 쓴다고 설명했어요.

sentences.en: Marta said that a local historian asked her permission to read her old letters.

sentences.en: Marta told Rosa that the best incentive to write was getting her reply.

sentences.text: Javier estudió informática, pero ahora trabaja en ventas.

sentences.text: Con los años, el vocabulario de las cartas de Marta se fue llenando de palabras del pueblo.
sentences.en: Over the years, the vocabulary in Marta's letters filled up with village words.

sentences.text: Javier buscó el número de la sala de juntas en el directorio de la empresa.
sentences.en: Javier looked up the boardroom's number in the company directory.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 회사 내선 목록에서 회의실 번호를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: Marta encontró la nueva dirección de Rosa en un directorio de antiguos alumnos.
sentences.en: Marta found Rosa's new address in an alumni directory.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 동창 명부에서 로사의 새 주소를 찾았어요.

sentences.text: A Javier se le pegó una tecla del portátil después de derramar el café.
sentences.en: One of the keys on Javier's laptop got stuck after he spilled his coffee.
sentences.ko: 하비에르가 커피를 쏟은 뒤로 노트북 자판 하나가 눌린 채 안 올라와요.

sentences.text: La vieja máquina de escribir de Marta tiene una tecla rota, así que la letra eñe sale torcida.
sentences.en: Marta's old typewriter has a broken key, so the letter ñ comes out crooked.
sentences.ko: 마르타의 오래된 타자기는 자판 하나가 고장 나서 ñ 글자가 삐뚤게 찍혀요.

sentences.text: Cuando cerraron la fábrica, el tío de Javier cobró una buena indemnización.
sentences.en: When the factory closed, Javier's uncle received good severance pay.
sentences.ko: 공장이 문을 닫았을 때 하비에르의 삼촌은 퇴직 보상금을 두둑이 받았어요.

sentences.text: Marta le contó a Rosa que, tras el accidente, el seguro le pagó una indemnización.
sentences.en: Marta told Rosa that after the accident, the insurance paid her compensation.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 사고 뒤 보험사에서 보상금을 받았다고 전했어요.

sentences.text: La jefa de Javier valora su aptitud para resolver conflictos con los clientes.
sentences.en: Javier's boss values his aptitude for resolving conflicts with clients.
sentences.ko: 하비에르의 상사는 고객과의 갈등을 푸는 그의 능력을 높이 사요.

sentences.text: Marta siempre admiró la aptitud de Rosa para los idiomas.
sentences.en: Marta always admired Rosa's aptitude for languages.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 늘 로사의 언어 재능을 부러워했어요.

sentences.text: Javier brindó con su equipo por un año próspero y lleno de proyectos.
sentences.en: Javier toasted with his team to a prosperous year full of projects.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 팀원들과 함께 프로젝트가 가득한 풍성한 한 해를 위해 건배했어요.

sentences.text: Al final de la carta, Marta le deseó a Rosa un año próspero y tranquilo.
sentences.en: At the end of the letter, Marta wished Rosa a prosperous and peaceful year.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 편지 끝에 로사에게 풍요롭고 평안한 한 해가 되길 빌었어요.

sentences.text: Javier pidió un anticipo del sueldo para pagar la entrada del piso.
sentences.en: Javier asked for an advance on his salary to pay the deposit on his flat.
sentences.ko: 하비에르는 아파트 계약금을 내려고 월급 가불을 신청했어요.

sentences.text: Marta le adelantó a Rosa, como anticipo, que el verano que viene irá a visitarla.
sentences.en: Marta told Rosa in advance, as a preview, that she'll come to visit her next summer.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 로사에게 미리 귀띔하듯 내년 여름에 찾아가겠다고 했어요.

sentences.text: El informático le enseñó a Javier a codificar los archivos antes de enviarlos.
sentences.en: The IT guy showed Javier how to encode the files before sending them.
sentences.ko: 전산 담당자가 하비에르에게 파일을 보내기 전에 암호화하는 법을 알려 줬어요.

sentences.text: De jóvenes, Marta y Rosa inventaron un alfabeto secreto para codificar sus cartas.
sentences.en: When they were young, Marta and Rosa invented a secret alphabet to encode their letters.
sentences.ko: 마르타와 로사는 젊을 때 편지를 암호로 쓰려고 비밀 문자를 만들었어요.
